paper_id: Li et al. - 2016 - Exploring Cross-Application Cellular Traffic Optimization with Baidu TrafficGuard
title: Exploring Cross-Application Cellular Traffic Optimization with Baidu TrafficGuard
motivation: 移动流量激增导致带宽上限和拥塞,现有方案仅限单一应用
problem_framing: 构建跨应用的透明流量优化代理系统,同时保证用户体验
key_insight: 测量发现文本压缩对短文本效果差(仅省1.36%流量),可放弃文本压缩改用轻量方案
method_signature: 云端VPN代理+自适应JPEG压缩+流量过滤+VBWC缓存
evaluation_criteria: 流量降低百分比、超额次数、延迟代价、电池消耗
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: EndRE方案虽可省10.2%流量但内存开销高数百倍,故被放弃;文本压缩因收效低且耗电被明确拒绝
evidence_for_taste: given the limited network efficiency gains and the toll on battery life, we opt to not compress texts
breaks the original functionality of websites
10.6% of images in TGdataset are broken
Even worse, the server-side memory overhead of EndRE can be hundreds of times higher
This is important because many UI layout algorithms (e.g., CSS) are sensitive to the pixel dimensions
67% of users have chosen to block ads
95.4% of users selected the ImgQFMiddle scheme
thinking_moves: 测量驱动:先观察实际流量特征再决策,非先假设再验证
逆向采纳:所有系统都压缩文本,但测量数据否定了此策略
工程权衡:宁可省10%计算开销,也拒绝可能破坏UI的激进压缩
低垂果实:明确指出10.6%损坏图片可丢弃,直接优化
成本拒绝:EndRE虽压缩率高,但内存开销数百倍于VBWC故放弃
